pieces.Text: You meld the stately forms of combat with a down-and-dirty style; no trick is beneath you. You never take a non-proficiency penalty on attack rolls with improvised weapons and you gain a +2 bonus on all combat maneuver checks. In addition, whenever you land a critical hit, you may choose to apply a random effect rather than dealing extra damage [d6: 1 - staggered 1 rnd; 2 - nauseated 1 rnd; 3 - deafened 1 rnd; 4 - blinded 1 rnd; 5 - sickened 1 min; 6 - fatigued]; these durations are doubled if the crit multiplier is x3, and tripled if it is x4.
